_about: Every input chapter 7's runs use. 'source' names the draft line that defines a value; a source starting UNDEFINED means the draft does not fix it and the value is a provisional choice Paolo has to confirm. run.py copies the UNDEFINED ones into every result as provisional_inputs.

runs.source: draft lines 48, 158, 177: median of five runs

seed.source: UNDEFINED: any fixed seed; the draft names none

yarn_override.source: draft line 181 '[chapter 6 long-context flags]' = chapter 6 draft line 35, in the form vLLM 0.30.0 accepts (chapter 6's engine.py YARN_V030): a yarn rope type no longer multiplies max_position_embeddings by its factor (vllm/config/model.py _get_and_verify_max_len), so the printed rope_scaling form stops at --max-model-len 131072; rope_theta is Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct's own, kept because the rope_scaling setter replaces the whole rope_parameters dict

completion_tokens.source: draft lines 99 and 344: the fixture's completion length

prefix_tokens.source: UNDEFINED: draft says '120k'. 120,000 matches its 3.4 GB at 28 KB per token (line 91); the book's k=1024 reading, 122,880, does not fit: 122,880 + 8,192 + 50 + 180 exceeds 131,072

cold_paste_tokens.source: draft line 199: 32,768 divided by 2,048 is sixteen

cold_paste_max_tokens.source: UNDEFINED: the paste's own answer length; set to the fixture's completion length

followup_mean_gap_s.source: UNDEFINED: arrival rate of follow-ups per session; exponential gaps, mean 20 s, so a session rarely has two answers in flight

replay_duration_s.source: UNDEFINED: how long each replay sends follow-ups

paste_at_s.source: UNDEFINED: when the cold paste lands inside the replay

followups_carry_history.source: UNDEFINED: each follow-up is prefix + session tail + its own 50 tokens; earlier answers are not appended

static_answer_lengths.source: UNDEFINED: draft line 158 says eight answers of 20 to 180 tokens; these are line 99's four lengths, twice

static_context.source: UNDEFINED: the eight follow-ups' context; set to the mini-session's own prompt plus 50 new tokens

continuous_max_num_seqs.source: UNDEFINED: the continuous side's slot count; 4, the same slots as the static side (figure 7.3)

admit128k_prompt_tokens.source: UNDEFINED: '128k request' read as 131,072 tokens of context including the 180-token answer

admit128k_stagger_s.source: UNDEFINED: 'sent together'; the second leaves 50 ms after the first so the order is fixed

sweep32k_points.source: draft lines 52-57 and 326 (writing plan item 14 says 1 to 32)

sweep32k_prompt_tokens.source: UNDEFINED: '32k context' read as 32,768 including the 180-token answer

sweep4k_prompt_tokens.source: UNDEFINED: '4k context' read as 4,096 including the 180-token answer

sweep_requests_per_point.source: UNDEFINED: each point sends as many sessions as its sequence cap

tpot_p99_definition.value: per run: p99 of the per-request TPOTs; reported as the median of five runs, plus the p99 pooled over all runs
tpot_p99_definition.source: UNDEFINED: with 1 to 6 requests a run, a per-run p99 is close to the run's maximum
